title: AI fabric signer-first protocol
description: Executable PSTF gate for Nostr-canonical AI/ML command, result, read-model, subscription, and relay protocol behavior.
in_scope: 38390-38399 AI/ML command/result namespace retained as legacy migration inventory and rejected from production runtime subscriptions/publication
31980-31989 AI/ML read-model namespace retained as legacy migration inventory and rejected from production runtime subscriptions
Canonical ContextVM 25910 signer-first AI/ML mutation publishing
Canonical ML read-model observation via d-tagged state and EOSE catch-up
Scoped subscriptions, correlation metadata, relay primitive OK/CLOSED/AUTH/EOSE handling, and HTTP-polling avoidance
out_of_scope: HF/vLLM production integration evidence owned by bahia-jicv
Changing pstf/features/AI_FABRIC_HF_VLLM_DEPLOYMENT except for separately coordinated cross-reference
Reopening runtime publication of legacy AI/ML custom kinds
preconditions: docs/nostr-event-implementation-guide.md is the repository authority for event-kind selection.
Production AI/ML mutation intent uses ContextVM 25910; legacy 38390-38399 and 31980-31989 constants remain for migration inventory and tests.
postconditions: Executable tests prove signer-first AI/ML command publishing, event injection handling, scoped subscriptions, EOSE read-model observation, and no HTTP polling/sleep completion in the ML browser route.
D-SFP-EXEC-001 is resolved by executable evidence.
happy_paths: Operator publishes an ML inference deployment as a signed ContextVM 25910 event with d-tag/progressToken/scoped tags and accepted relay count.
Subscriber injects a canonical ML read-model state event, persists it once, invokes handlers once, then marks historical catch-up complete on EOSE.
failure_paths: No relay accepts an ML command publish, so the publisher returns an error instead of a submitted receipt.
Injected ML model import request missing d tag returns a canonical ContextVM validation failure with e/p/status/model correlation.
Relay primitive CLOSED before EOSE does not produce false completion; AUTH-required subscription failures fail closed without fallback.
edge_cases: Legacy AI/ML 38390/38394 and read-model 31980/31986 kinds are omitted from runtime subscriber filters.
Scoped operator subscription authors are deduplicated across default, adoption, and direct-runtime scopes.
non_functional_requirements: Nostr-native event-driven semantics; no HTTP polling as completion truth.
Deterministic tests use injected events/handlers and do not sleep to wait for completion.
